versions.content: Gatewaying of a MultiplexedIPdu in System Extract/ECU Extract • StaticPart and DynamicPart definitions shall be omitted, thus no ISig- nalIPdu description shall be included • all attributes of the MultiplexedIPdu shall be omitted. • a PduTriggering shall be defined only for the gatewayed MultiplexedIPdu • an IPduMapping between the source and the target PduTriggering s shall be defined
